question: How do you prioritise your work when you have multiple deadlines?
purposeOfQuestion: Interviewer evaluates ability to manage competing demands.
exampleAnswer: I use an impact-effort matrix to categorise tasks. First, I identify which tasks are both urgent and important — those get done immediately. For important but not urgent tasks, I schedule dedicated time blocks. I communicate proactively with stakeholders when deadlines conflict. For example, last month I had three concurrent deliverables and used this approach to complete all on time by negotiating a two-day extension on the least critical item.
evaluationCriteria: Systematic approach, stakeholder communication, concrete example, outcome
followUpQuestions: How do you handle a situation where everything is urgent?
What tools do you use for task management?
How do you communicate competing priorities to your manager?
